organization.name: VelvoCart Online Marketplace
organization.description: VelvoCart is a premier e-commerce marketplace offering over 15 million products across consumer electronics, fashion, home & living, pantry groceries, and third-party merchant goods. VelvoCart serves over 18 million active shoppers across North America with same-day express delivery, VelvoCart Prime subscriptions, and integrated VelvoPay digital wallet services.
